meta.name: product-launch-video
meta.description: Turn a product or marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a product launch / promo video — SaaS promos, feature reveals, product demos, app and company launches. Use when the user wants to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; the default for any commercial URL. Site tours / showcases of a website route here too — the brief carries the show-it-as-is intent. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把产品链接或文案转成发布宣传视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的产品要发布或展示,需要宣传视频。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a product link or script into a launch video.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're launching a product or feature and need a quick promo video.

howto.what: 把产品网址、粘贴的脚本或简报变成一支宣传视频:自动抓取网页素材和品牌色/字体,选定设计模板,编排故事板与旁白,逐帧生成画面,最后渲染成 mp4 文件。
howto.when: 当用户想营销、发布、推广等目的,或给出产品/营销网址时触发;网站导览/展示请求也走此流程。意图不明确时转 /hyperframes。

say.text: 把我们的 SaaS 产品网址做成 30 秒宣传视频
say.note: 会抓取该网址并开始搭建视频项目。

say.text: 用这段产品文案制作一条发布视频
say.note: 会据此写故事板和脚本。

say.text: 做一条新功能展示视频,重点表现界面
say.note: 会按网站导览方式截屏并展示。

howto.what_en: Turns a product URL, pasted script, or brief into a launch/promo video: captures web assets and brand tokens, picks a design preset, writes storyboard and script, builds frames, and renders a final mp4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user wants to market, launch, promote, etc., or provides a commercial URL; also handles site tour/showcase requests. Unclear intents go to /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Turn our SaaS product URL into a 30-second promo video.
say_en.note: It will capture the URL and start the project setup.

say_en.text: Make a launch video from this product copy.
say_en.note: It will draft the storyboard and script from it.

say_en.text: Create a feature-reveal video focusing on the interface.
say_en.note: It will capture the site and present it as a tour.
